what: Reconstructed SONCC coho critical habitat, BOTH STATES. DERIVED, not an official NMFS layer.
why: NMFS has never published spatial data for this ESU's critical habitat
authority: 50 CFR 226.210; 64 FR 24049 (1999-05-05); Table 6 to Part 226, verified against eCFR 2026-09-11
method: distribution ∩ Table 6 unit ∩ listed counties ∩ ESU extent (NOAA ds803 range, Cape Blanco to Punta Gorda) − basins above the 11 Table 6 boundary dams
oregon_distribution: ODFW FHD 1167_5 fhd_Coho WHERE fhdAccess = 'Unassisted' AND fhdUseTy <> 'Historical' AND fhdLifeHst = 'Anadromous' AND fhdOrig = 'NativeLocal'
california_distribution: CDFW BIOS ds326 Coho Distribution, August 2025 (observed since 1990)
caveats: DERIVED, not an official NMFS layer. Label it everywhere; never render it like the NOAA layers.
Two claim types: ODFW documented-accessible distribution (OR), CDFW observed distribution (CA). claim_type on every reach.
California half understates the designation: observed is a subset of accessible.
Circular as an input to miles-opened: some reaches exist because a dam was removed and coho recolonised.
Iron Gate is still the legal boundary although removed in 2024; the designation has not been amended.
Display copy is simplified ~33 m. Joins use the full-resolution GeoPackage only (standing rule 35).
